_schema: Provenance-aware Base Rated Rookie (#301-400) evidence table, v2 (2026-09-04). Every field that starts with a source name (checklistInsider/beckett/footballCardShop/tcdb/marketplaceSearch/searchSynthesis/beckettAutographParallel/freshDCards/sportsCardInvestor) preserves exactly what that source said - never merged/overwritten. Top-level player/team is a display value only, preferring the highest-tier directly-named source when multiple agree (beckett > tcdb > footballCardShop > checklistInsider), and preserving the higher-tier value even where a lower-tier/marketplace source disagrees (see #345 SOURCE_CONFLICT - the conflicting freshDCards value is kept in its own field, never silently adopted or discarded).

_verificationStatusVocabulary.ONE_SOURCE_VERIFIED: Exactly one directly-named, specifically-attributed source covers this card number (checklistInsider/beckett/footballCardShop/tcdb).
_verificationStatusVocabulary.TWO_SOURCE_VERIFIED: Two or more directly-named sources cover this card number and agree on player AND team. Independence assessed per-pair, not assumed - see AUDIT.
_verificationStatusVocabulary.SOURCE_CONFLICT: Two or more sources disagree on player or team for the same card number. The higher-tier/majority value is shown at top level for readability, but the row is NOT treated as verified and the disagreement is preserved in full, never silently resolved.
_verificationStatusVocabulary.SEARCH_SYNTHESIS_UNCONFIRMED: Only a web-search-engine synthesis, a bundled/unnamed marketplace-source claim, or a non-base-subset (e.g. autograph/parallel checklist) piece of evidence covers this number - explicitly weaker than a directly-named base-checklist source, never counted toward the two-source gate.
_verificationStatusVocabulary.MISSING_EVIDENCE: No evidence of any kind - not present as an actual row in this pass (0 such rows remain).

_independenceNote_TCDB_vs_FootballCardSh: Overlap at #332-334 and #348-349 (5 rows): all 5 agree exactly on player and team once FootballCardShop's abbreviations are expanded. TCDB uses full team names natively; FootballCardShop uses abbreviations - the same formatting-divergence signal already used to treat Beckett/FootballCardShop and Checklist Insider/Beckett as plausibly independent. Same caveat as before: this is a judgment call based on user-supplied text, not a side-by-side read of the live pages (tcdb.com and footballcardshop.com both EGRESS_BLOCKED this session) - not assumed independent merely because the domains differ, per instruction; recommend a human check before production.
_conflictNote_345: Will Campbell #345: TCDB says New England Patriots (consistent with his actual 2025 NFL landing spot). A FreshDCards article instead lists his affiliation as 'LSU Tigers' - a college team, not an NFL team, which strongly suggests that particular FreshDCards mention is describing his college background rather than giving his 2025 Donruss card's NFL team field, OR is simply an error. Per instruction, this was NOT normalized away - kept as an explicit SOURCE_CONFLICT with both values preserved.
_beckettAutographParallelNote_312: #312 RJ Harvey/Denver Broncos is corroborated by Beckett's 'Rated Rookies Autographs Orange' checklist - a parallel/autograph product tier that reuses the same base numbering, NOT the Base Rated Rookie checklist itself. Per explicit instruction, this does NOT promote #312 to a base-verified status on its own - kept at SEARCH_SYNTHESIS_UNCONFIRMED with the autograph-parallel evidence recorded as a supporting note, not as base-checklist proof.
